purpose: Assess direction sensitivity and cross-configuration persistence of the paired WCL intercept-refitting intervention without changing the original experiment suite.
selection_context: Chosen after the historical results and Access desk rejection were known. This is not retrospective preregistration and not an independent deployment validation.
target_selection: Most selected receivers on each fixed reference population, ranked before perturbations; numeric ID breaks equal-count ties. Baseline assessment confirms these top-1/top-2 identities on both maps. No outcome-based target selection.
calibration_scope: Same original calibration observations; fit once on each reference for frozen arm, refit on the identical perturbed map for paired refit arm.
seed_rule: 8800 + k + 101*r, r=0,...,31; NumPy default_rng; consume one uniform angle [0,2*pi) for each targeted receiver in numeric ID order.
continuity_rule: R29 r=0,1 are historical two-field bridge cases. Other refitted cases can already exist in the earlier rank suite. Do not label all 32 fields as unseen or statistically independent replication of previous conclusions.
coupling: Within every pair the perturbed coordinates, targets, directions, selected RSSI observations, messages and scoring function are identical. The seed depends on k: comparisons across k are not nested common-vector causal tests. Native map populations differ even at equal N.
primary_estimand: delta_r = median_q(error_frozen[q,r]) - median_q(error_refit[q,r]); positive means smaller median error with refitting.
primary_reporting: For each of four map/k cells: all 32 paired values; median, IQR, min-max of delta_r; counts of positive/zero/negative differences.
Absolute arm medians in metres and percentage change relative to the same native clean reference.
Report median(delta_r) separately from median(M_frozen_r)-median(M_refit_r); they need not agree.
No fabricated population-level confidence interval from 2498*32 nominal independent observations.
secondary_predefined_diagnostics: Touched-message mask H_q intersects T; report its size and errors within that fixed subset alongside full-population results.
Untouched messages must have invariant predictions because neither their coordinates nor receiver-specific calibration entries change.
All selected sets have at least three receivers and only k=1 or2 are perturbed, so each retains at least one unperturbed selected receiver; verify rather than infer an error guarantee.
Record receiver intercept changes and normalized WCL weight mass on corrupted receivers; descriptive mechanism check, not a novel universal predictor.
Save full per-message error arrays and prediction vectors, all field vectors, intercept fits, ordered identities, reference outputs and environment.
gates: Both unperturbed native WCL medians match original recorded references at declared reporting precision.
Calibration/evaluation ordered identities and content separation match the original sampling contract.
Empty-target and zero-displacement checks reproduce reference for both arms.
No reference-map mutation and only target coordinates change.
Within-pair selected receivers and observations match exactly; no silent message drop.
Predictions/error arrays finite and dimensions correct.
R29 r=0,1 summary agrees with historical S5 values at published one-decimal percentage precision.
Field and source manifests are fixed before evaluating extended outputs.
result_handling: Retain every scheduled completed outcome, including reversals and weak effects. Broader persistence is conditional on outcomes. If effects are configuration-specific, narrow the conclusion. Never change seeds, targets, effect thresholds or sample size to obtain a favorable result.
time_limit: At most two working days for the addition. First benchmark one known bridge pair, then choose run/no-run based on feasibility, not favorable extended outcomes. If a started run cannot finish, preserve completed records and state incompleteness; do not report a selected successful subset as the planned completed experiment.
exclusions: No new solver, no new physical deployment, no full corruption surface rerun, no co-occurrence-causality experiment, no G4/G6 reclassification, no new subgroup claim inferred from marginal percentiles.
current_execution: No paired outputs evaluated in this execution at freeze time. Original baseline and published bridge numbers are known.
scope_note: Local prespecified extension protocol, not a publicly registered or prospectively independent study.
